soundness_flags.label: def:sa-csid-handle; def:sa-csid-machine; oeq:all-residual-dichotomy; thm:formula-or-global-twin-completeness
soundness_flags.one_line: The purported transition system never defines the eligibility predicates, actions, or outputs of selector correction, reachable fixing, labelled rational elimination, residual compilation, or its kernel tokens, so priority and a decreasing counter do not yet define a machine whose termination or completeness can be stated.

soundness_flags.label: thm:normalization-equivalence
soundness_flags.one_line: Because I_H is defined as the image of Theta_H and N_H is stipulated to retain every coordinate and store inverse syntax, mutual inverses and equality of the attainable relation are currently definition unfolds rather than a substantive theorem.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper states that SS-ID is sound, proves nonidentification for failures at Algorithm 1 lines 4 and 14 and Algorithm 2 line 3, and says it conjectures completeness.
Under an observational positivity assumption, the paper presents a sound and complete general-identifiability algorithm by decomposition into classical identification subproblems.
The paper gives a sound and complete algorithm for CSI relations limited to observed root nodes, which is distinct from an endogenous selector model.
The paper gives a necessary-and-sufficient graphical characterization and a sound-and-complete formula-or-hedge identification algorithm for ordinary recursive semi-Markovian models.
The paper reduces discrete-observed SCM counterfactual distributions to canonical SCMs with finite exogenous domains and uses polynomial programming for optimal bounds.

The paper supplies sufficient pruning and clustering conditions for data fusion, including transfer of identification conclusions and identifying functionals, rather than fixed-support endogenous-selector image equivalence.
The paper derives influence-function and efficient estimation strategies for identified effects in broad hidden-variable graphical-model classes.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace each named SA-CS-ID rule with a finite formal transition relation: state precondition, transformed state, emitted circuit/twin object, and proof obligation; then make the schedule range only over those defined transitions.
Define the normalized parameter carrier independently from retained primitive response tables and gate equalities, then prove that its image is exactly Theta_H rather than defining I_H as that image.
Add a fully worked nontrivial selector-gated instance that executes every new transition type and computes either its rational circuit/domain or an explicit support-exact twin pair.

Separate the graphical completeness theorem from the uniform all-admissible-cell lower bound, retaining only branch-interior positivity for Wald inference or documenting a concrete finite design where the stronger bound is credible.

recommended_next_step: Revise the calculus into an actually specified finite transition system and make normalization non-definitional; then retain the field-grade fixed-support completeness target for Stage 0.
